script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be list at (globalRegister's 'bpIdx').
If call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.check with (arg), then
  If v's 'ultimateFatedCircleIntervalTurnAiArg', then call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.add with (arg, "turnForUltimateFatedCircle").
  Let lastAbility be the last move of executer.
  If the main move id of lastAbility is the id of the move labelled "ultimate_fated_circle" on executer, then call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.reset with (arg, "turnForUltimateFatedCircle").

flow.text: Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be list at (globalRegister's 'bpIdx').
call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.check with (arg)

yes.text: Let lastAbility be the last move of executer.
the main move id of lastAbility is the id of the move labelled "ultimate_fated_circle" on executer

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let container be the group of executer.
If arg → get-condition-flag-in-frame with ("damaged_all"), then
  Let v be _ → find with (list3, given (x) { Let number be the numeric entry x's 'rateAiArg' in the battle settings of container. Return util passes a fraction roll of number. }).
  If not v, then return v.
  Let ability be the id of the move labelled v's 'abilityTag' on executer.
  Let v2 be call helper4 with (arg, ability).
  If v2, then executer uses the built-in move BUILTIN_ENEMY_MULTIPLE_ABILITY immediately with options {multipleAbilitySettings: call helper5 with (v2, true), isCounter: true} and timing {interruptCounter: true}.
  Otherwise, executer uses ability immediately with options {isCounter: true} and timing {interruptCounter: true}.

Let container be the group of executer.
arg → get-condition-flag-in-frame with ("damaged_all")

Executer uses the built-in move BUILTIN_ENEMY_MULTIPLE_ABILITY immediately with options {multipleAbilitySettings: call helper5 with (v2, true), isCounter: true} and timing {interruptCounter: true}.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of executer.
Let bpIdx be globalRegister's 'bpIdx'.
Let hpRate2 be the phase for executer under the phases list with HP fraction hpRate from phase bpIdx.
If bpIdx is not hpRate2, then
  Let v be list at hpRate2.
  Executer changes to stat block the stat block of form v's 'paramSuffixNo' on executer.
  Executer cancels its cast.
  Set globalRegister's 'bpIdx' to hpRate2.

Let list4 be [{abilityTag: arg1's 'abilityTagForDraw', abilityOptions: {skipStepCnt: true, isCounter: arg2}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: arg1's 'messageSuffixNo'}]]}}, {conditions: {anyCanHit: true}, abilityTag: arg1's 'abilityTagForMain', abilityOptions: {skipAttackMotion: true, skipMessage: arg1's 'skipMessage', skipStepCnt: arg2}}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let container be the group of executer.
Let v be list at (globalRegister's 'bpIdx').
If executer is ready to act, then
  Let v2 be nothing.
  If v's 'ultimateFatedCircleIntervalTurnAiArg', then
    If the numeric entry v's 'ultimateFatedCircleIntervalTurnAiArg' in the battle settings of container is at most globalRegister's 'turnForUltimateFatedCircle', then set v2 to the id of the move labelled "ultimate_fated_circle" on executer.
  If not v2, then set v2 to executer → without-and-lot-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
  Let v3 be call helper4 with (arg, v2).
  If v3, then
    Let v4 be call helper5 with (v3, false).
    Executer uses v2 with its cast time and then v4.
  Otherwise, executer uses v2.
